aboutP: Fight Factory is a genuine combat gym: an 18ft raised ring, heavy bag wall, Dollamur mat arena and an iron & S&C zone — with coaches who've prepped world-championship camps. Integrated with Gym OS for instant lead response, express QR check-in and member tracking.

programCards.desc: Foundation tech, footwork, mitt work and competition sparring — from first wrap to fight prep at championship level.

timetableP: Every class is coached by a specialist — book your spot on WhatsApp and it lands directly with the team.
trainersP: Coaches who've prepped world-championship camps, fought pro, and designed fight-endurance programs — real people, real credentials.
membershipP: Three honest tiers: £10 day pass, £45/month Factory Standard, £75/month Pro Combat Unlimited with every discipline and sparring. No long-term contracts.
facilitiesP: A real combat gym built for work: 18ft raised ring, heavy bag wall, Dollamur mat arena and an iron & S&C zone.
recoveryP: Priority fight prep coaching on Pro Combat, with weight-cut protocols and fight endurance programs designed by our S&C specialist.
fourthPanelP: Sat from 09:30 · full timetable above. Express QR check-in with Gym OS.
trialP: Book a free trial session, meet the coaches, train your discipline — then decide with total clarity.
